title: Vanilla Milk
description: This is a lightweight modpack enhances the Minecraft experience while retaining the fundamental mechanics and improving immersion and VFX.
body:
!['Vanilla Milk' text in stylized, blocky text on a black background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d79ce13b5666100462229ee6cd046154ebff205_0.webp)


<details>
<summary>Announcements</summary>
- This modpack is in active development. The developer is planning on porting it to newer and older versions once the 1.0.0-release releases. Thanks for downloading!
</details>



This modpack is built for Minecraft 1.21.8, focused on survival. It keeps the game feeling familiar but adds a few small changes that make it more enjoyable. You don’t need experience with mods to get started, but even seasoned players will notice it runs smoother and feels a bit nicer to play.

It improves textures and sounds just enough to feel cleaner, and fixes little rough spots that can make vanilla feel clunky. Nothing major is changed—you’ll still be playing the game you know, only slightly better.

## Features

**Visual and Audio Tweaks**
- Cleaner textures and sounds that don’t feel out of place
- Works with shaders like Complementary for brighter lighting
- Keeps the classic Minecraft look intact

**Vanilla-Focused Survival**
- Game mechanics and progression remain unchanged
- Ready for singleplayer or hardcore mode
- Small improvements that help without adding complexity

**Optimized for Mid-Range Hardware**
- Doesn’t require a high-end computer
- Balances nicer visuals with smooth performance
- Focused on stability

**Beginner-Friendly Modpack**
- A good starting point if you’re new to modding
- Only includes mods that make survival easier or more pleasant
- Provides a foundation you can expand on as you get more comfortable

## Why Try It?

If you want survival to feel a little fresher, this pack does that without changing the core of the game. Exploring, building, and surviving all run a bit smoother and feel more engaging, while still keeping the charm of vanilla Minecraft.

Please report bugs in the linked Discord Server.
